# RideLens

> Every ride, one comparison. Map the trip once on live roads, then line up Uber,
> Lyft, Empower and Curb side by side, ranked by price, soonest pickup or value.

Quote types are kept distinct and never averaged into one invented number: an
upfront price stays upfront, a range stays a range, an estimate is labelled as one,
and a stale quote never wins. The final fare is always confirmed in the provider app.

## What it does

- Routes the trip once, on live roads, and reuses that route for every provider.
- Applies each published rate card, the local fee stack and a marketplace model
  that moves with time of day, hotspots and weather.
- Ranks by price, soonest, or value, and shows the pickup wait beside each fare.
